# MeshAid Tactical C2
> Decentralized offline emergency communications protocol and field telemetry console.

- Protocol: 96-byte Ed25519-signed binary wire frames over BLE Extended Advertising.
- Architecture: Store-Carry-Forward Delay-Tolerant Networking (DTN).
- Core Modules: Tactical GIS Radar, Triage Stream, Protocol Wire Spec, Field Handset Runbook.
